Subjects then responded to the pictures according to the cued instruction followed by their rating of the perceived valence on a 9-point Likert scale (1 = very unpleasant, 5 = neutral, 9 = very pleasant) by pressing a button (9 s).

instructions.value: An arrow cue instructed participants either to reduce the negative emotions induced by the pictures, reduce the positive emotions induced by the pictures, or simply view the pictures without regulating. For regulation, participants used strategies of their own choice, selected during practice; after each picture set they rated perceived valence on a 9-point Likert scale.

spans.text: First, an arrow was displayed in the center of the screen for three seconds, the direction of which cued the subjects as to whether they should reduce their negative emotions (up arrow “↑”) or positive emotions (down arrow “↓”), or simply view the pictures (equal sign “=”).
